And the meaning of the word “congregation” is, in turn, learned from the spies by means of a verbal analogy between one instance of the word “congregation” and another instance of the word “congregation.” There, with regard to the spies, it is written: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation?” (Numbers 14:27), indicating ten people, as there were twelve spies altogether, and Joshua and Caleb were not included in the evil congregation. The same applies to sanctifying God’s name, which must be done in the presence of ten people.
